title: Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography
summary: The risk of post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography(ERCP) pancreatitis(PEP) is influenced by patient and procedure-related factors. Strategies to decrease PEP(Post-Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography Pancreatitis) are of great importance.

interventions.name: Patients undergoing ERCPs at Methodist Dallas Medical Center

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients \>15 years Included in MDI's Registry Underwent ERCP between January 1, 2000 through December 31, 2025

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients \<15 years Patients in which cannulation was via a surgical anastomosis Patients in which cannulation was not attempted due to gastric outlet obstruction, the main papilla not found, or the minor papilla was not found will be excluded.
